description: Fill form fields (AcroForm) in a PDF and return the filled PDF. Fields are addressed by name (pdf_inspect lists the names); the label printed next to a field or a near-miss name is also accepted, and the result lists every key that was matched that way. All values are strings; checkboxes take "true"/"false"; dropdown/radio/optionlist values must be one of the field's options; text values must respect the field's maxLength from pdf_inspect. The source PDF is never modified. Returns the filled PDF inline as an application/pdf resource. Owner-locked PDFs (empty user password, common for government blanks) fill without a password; a user-password PDF needs the password parameter, otherwise it is rejected with encrypted_pdf.

fields.description: Field name → string value (from pdf_inspect's fillTemplate)

flatten.description: Bake values into page content and drop the AcroForm so fields are no longer editable

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: Template PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_fill

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

field_map.description: Present only when a key was matched forgivingly: {provided key: actual field name}. Exact-name keys are omitted

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

warning.description: Present as xfa-layer-dropped when a hybrid AcroForm/XFA input lost its XFA layer

title: Fill PDF form
